candidates.passage: And somewhere we are getting closer to our targets for 2030 much earlier, whether it is water replenishment, whether it is specific hazards, whether it is a reduction in specific effluent generation or it is about the Scope 1 & 2 emissions, along with the usage of recycled plastic in packaging.
